article.content: ⚽ Premier League updates from the 5.30pm BST kick-off ⚽ Aston Villa 2-1 Man City | Live scores | Table | Mail Scott The teams take to the pitch. Chelsea in blue, Spurs in white, and it won’t be long before every shirt is soaking wet. Has the signature work of the Harry J All Stars ever been so apposite? We’ll be off in a couple of minutes. Roberto De Zerbi also speaks to Sky. “James Maddison is a very important player … he brings personality, qualities, experience … a different position on the pitch … he’s a different player to Conor Gallagher or [Omar] Marmoush as a number ten … we have to find him in the right moment in the best position … [Dominic Solanke] felt fatigue after Coventry … I am lucky to have a big squad with many different solutions … so I took the decision [to rest him] but the game is 90 minutes.” Continue reading...

According to [Sport | The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2026/oct/24/chelsea-v-tottenham-premier-league-live), the 5:30 PM BST kick-off followed a busy day of top-flight action across England, which included Aston Villa securing a tight 2-1 victory over Manchester City. 

As supporters tuned in to follow the proceedings, broadcasting schedules and viewing options had dominated discussions earlier in the day, as detailed in our guide on [how to watch Chelsea v Spurs on TV channels and live streams](https://new-sfeed.lovable.app/en/articles/premier-league-today-how-to-watch-chelsea-v-spurs-tv-channels-live). ## Tactical Battles and Weather Conditions

The report states that the players emerged from the tunnel into the wet evening air, with **Chelsea** sporting their traditional blue kits and **Tottenham** lining up in white. The challenging weather conditions immediately set a physical tone for the encounter, raising questions about how ball control and tactical plans would hold up on a slick surface. Observers noted that the early stages of the match would likely test both squads' adaptability as the rain intensified.
